Banana Oat Pancakes

These pancakes are soft and sweet without any added sugar. They are a favourite on slow weekend mornings, and they take only fifteen minutes from start to finish. Serves 2.

Ingredients

  • 2 ripe bananas
  • 1 cup rolled oats
  • 2 eggs
  • a splash of milk

Method

  1. Mash the bananas in a bowl with a fork.
  2. Stir in the oats, the eggs and the milk.
  3. Cook small spoonfuls in a hot pan for two minutes on each side.

Read more in our guide to frying pans before you start cooking these.
